scope: source-only scheduled weather-forecast provider credential routing

finding.summary: The isolated weather-forecast worker expected a worker-namespaced provider key in its child environment, but the worker read the shared legacy setting and Kernel worker Compose profiles did not declare the namespaced key.
finding.impact: Scheduled signed forecast ingestion could fail its provider-key preflight even when the forecast worker credential pair and the default-off feature setting were configured.

changes: Read KOKONUT_WEATHER_FORECAST_OPENWEATHERMAP_API_KEY directly in the forecast worker and reject a missing or blank key before credential/database access.
Allow the shared legacy fetch function to receive an explicit provider key while preserving its legacy default for existing callers.
Route the dedicated key into the Kernel standard and portability worker environments; the feature remains false by default.
Document the dedicated key name in .env.example without adding a value.

weather_forecast_worker_and_provider_sui.command: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_weather_forecast_worker.py tests/test_worker_environment.py tests/test_weather_forecast.py tests/test_weather_forecast_atomicity.py tests/test_weather_forecast_cli_scope.py

checks.compose_contract: PyYAML parsed both worker profiles; each routes the namespaced key and keeps the feature default-off

limitations: No database or live provider was contacted.
No .env or SOPS secret file was read or changed.
Live OpenWeatherMap authentication, scheduler delivery, and deployment acceptance remain open.
